text_zh: 流沙流已倾。
text_en: The sand does not wait for the faithful.

text_zh: 每一击皆有代价——铅字落，沙亦流。
text_en: Each stroke costs more than faith alone can pay.

text_zh: 炉火不受控制地愈燃愈烈。
text_en: The furnace does not remember how to slow.

text_zh: 震颤之后，铅字冻于半空——汝之手，无处落。
text_en: After the tremor, the press seizes. The hands find nothing.

text_zh: 已铸之版，重新受验。沙漏倒悬——逾时，炉火吞其全数。
text_en: The press turns back. What was sealed must be sealed again, or lost entire.

text_zh:
结晶渐失其形——
保有之物，引擎亦索其半。
text_en: What you have inscribed, the Engine reclaims. Crystal does not hold forever.

text_zh:
每一词皆有其量——
铅字不过门槛，门槛便是天花。
text_en: The press will not yield beyond its measure. Each word meets the same ceiling of lead.

text_zh:
引擎之门，今夜开得更深——
汝须铸出双倍之重，方能叩响。
text_en: The gate stands twice as far. Strike harder, or the Engine will not hear you.

text_zh:
每一词落版，铅字便轻一分——
诵至末页，声已如蚊鸣。
text_en: Each impression lighter than the last. By the final word, the press barely whispers.

text_zh:
引擎先取其份——
汝所铸之字，非皆属汝。
text_en: Before the crystal sets, the Engine takes its portion. What remains is yours. What remains.

text_zh:
铅流涸竭
"圣字钉犹落，其声渐哑。"
text_en:
The Humour Drought
"The slugs still fall. Their ring grows hollow."

text_zh:
字迹消隐
"未铭之字，先行而去。"
text_en:
The Fading Script
"Letters flee before the hand descends."

text_zh:
乱版铭刻
"版已散乱——字序自有其律。"
text_en:
The Scattered Forme
"The type is loose. Read what remains."

text_zh:
逆序祷击
"末字先落，起始在后。"
text_en:
The Backward Litany
"Strike the last word first. Then find the beginning."

text_zh:
刺符乱经
"异符入经，铅字之间生荆棘。"
text_en:
The Punctured Word
"Strange marks nest between the sacred slugs."

text_zh: 引擎亦铸伪词——其形如律，其质如蜡。汝若信之，铅字坠落时，炉膛不计汝之功；汝若疑之，莫动，莫动。
text_en: Even the Engine casts false words. Their shape holds. Their weight does not. Trust neither the letter nor your hands.

text_zh:

另：本次更换的旧沙漏已检验，沙量无误，流速无误。但沙粒已呈红褐色，与长期氧化状态一致。购置日期：本月。

签名栏：维护主任 ████ / 收容记录室 ████ / 教务长 [空白]

Subject: Calibration Discrepancy, Layer ██ Casting Stations (Follow-up #██)
From: Engineering Maintenance / To: D-Class Personnel Assignment

All hourglass timers at Layer ██ casting stations have been inspected and found consistent with the central oil-clock. No deviation recorded.

D-class personnel assigned to this layer continue to report that time is insufficient for standard inscription duties. This office has replaced hourglass units on ██ occasions. Each replacement has calibrated within normal parameters.

Data archived. Assignment office is advised to arrange substitution as appropriate. No further action required.

Subject: Ironpress Boiler Cycle Irregularity (Follow-up #██)

Origin Site: Transitional passage, Layers XI–XII. Boilers #7 and #8.
First Filed: M.2██, following routine furnace inspection #██.

Observed: Boiler #7 casting-pressure cycle has continued to shorten without external adjustment. Current interval is no longer comparable to baseline measurements on record.

D-class personnel assigned to the corridor report that the pace of inscription ████ ████ ████. Three separate accounts were submitted. Each account described a different duration. Each account was internally consistent.

Boilers #7 and #8 serviced per standard maintenance schedule. No mechanical fault identified. Cycle continues to shorten.

Personnel attrition in the zone: within acceptable parameters. Replacements requisitioned under §4.2. Attrition rate has not been re-evaluated since initial filing.

Status: Listed as recurring variance. No escalation initiated.

text_en:
Internal Memorandum · Boundary Zone, Layer VI–VII
Subject: Lectern Response Anomaly, Casting Station ██ (Follow-up ██)
From: Engineering Division
To: Containment Administration

The following was first recorded at Station ██, Layer VI, on M.2██/██/██: following a Containment Tremor during active inscription, the lectern ceased response. Engineering dispatched for calibration. Mechanical status: normal. Oil pressure: normal. Leaden glyph temperature: normal.

The operator's hands remained on the keys.

Monitoring personnel D-████ reported the condition persisted for a duration he described as ████. His timepiece was later found stopped. Replacement arranged per §4.2. The station has since been reassigned to six consecutive operators. Response anomaly recurs in each case following the first Tremor logged per session. Engineering has reclassified the fault as operator-side. No further action indicated.

主题：关于第 █ 次登塔作业中出现
text_en:
Inter-Departmental Countersign · Layer IX Special Operation Request

Subject: Re-initiation of Ascent Sequence — Observation of Temporal Displacement in Impression Records

Background: A Clavigerant Novitiate completed Layer IX containment operations within recorded parameters. Upon re-entry to the same layer, the lectern's impression log displayed countdown values referencing a threshold not yet established at time of first entry. Engineering confirms the log timestamp predates the original ascent by ██ hours.

Observation: The iron press at Station 4-C showed oxidation consistent with extended disuse. Oil flask levels registered full. The D-████ assigned to re-entry reported the corridor 'had already been walked.' Personal log submitted via F-017 (7th filing).

Conclusion: Layer IX re-entry operations are designated time-sensitive. Exceedance of the pre-recorded threshold results in automatic deduction of all remaining hourglass reserves. Mechanism origin: not determined. Classification: Mobilum.

Countersign Status — Containment Division: [signed] / Engineering Division: [signed] / ████ Division: [blank]

No further action required pending third signature.

SUBJECT: Crystalline Humour Output Anomaly, Layers VI–IX (Follow-up #██)
FROM: Office of Quota Oversight / TO: Resource Coordination Bureau

This follows F-017 series submissions on file. Present follow-up is #██.

Since ██ of M.2██, crystalline humour accrued during Rites of Sealing across the above layers has ceased accumulation upon reaching the containment threshold. Type-frames, lead furnaces, and lecterns on all affected layers have been individually inspected by Engineering. Equipment status: nominal. Personnel status reports: nominal.

D-████ (Layer VIII) submitted a verbal observation: the lead slugs felt ████ after the threshold was crossed. Observation has been logged. No follow-up action indicated.

text_en:
Subject: Layer ██ Pressroom Yield Anomaly (Follow-up #██)
From: Pressroom Inspection Office → Containment Log Division
Date: M.██████

This is the ██th submission of this follow-up form.

All key-lectern readings: nominal. Operator logs: nominal. Lead-furnace temperature: nominal. Type-tray calibration: within tolerance.

However: upon completion of inscription, two randomly selected inscription folios are found with wear patterns on their final pages — not consistent with handling. Wear direction opposes binding direction. Pattern appears only in that session's output.

D-████ reported that at the close of each litany-strike, the completed folio felt 'lighter than it should have been.' Operator was replaced per §4.2. Replacement reported the same.

Building maintenance has been notified. Work order status: open.

No escalation recommended at this time.

First logged M.2██. During standard inscription work, select sacred slugs on the Claviculum Sanctum ceased registering in the character ledger mid-operation. MEMO: Vaults VI–VIII Corridor Anomaly (Follow-up No. ██)
From: Vault Six Area Inspector → Containment Records Division

During this cycle's standard inspection, Keybound D-████ through D-████ each reported encountering, during inscription procedure, words they did not recognise. Separately, each confirmed they had completed the inscription correctly. Transcripts of their accounts have been attached as Supplement ██.

Words flagged as unrecognised are not absent from the Canonical Register. Each appears under its correct entry. Upon return to the relevant corridor, personnel were unable to locate the word they had previously inscribed.
